interpretation: S changed the actual normalized generator displacement on all 31 noninitial real panels in each of four available windows.
No tested panel showed the registered first-order reversal of a useful fresh transport correction.
Finite transport loss increased on many real panels despite the first-order check; broad finite-step stability and superiority over T or W are not established.
The synthetic repeated-real control has no original-window credit and T/S generator displacements matched on all 32 panels.
Each proposal restored the original model state; only designated channel history advanced between panel observations. Critic, schedule and original RNG streams did not advance.
